RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the December 6, 2004/Agrahayana 15, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Culture; Development of North-Eastern
Region; Heavy Industries  and Public Enterprises; Human Resource Development;
Information and Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Parliamentary Affairs; Social
Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Urban Development; Urban
Employment and Poverty Alleviaion)
Total number of questions — 20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Saraswati River Heritage Project
*61. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister  of
CULTURE  be pleased to state the progress
made in the project on unearthing the
Saraswati River Heritage?
Protection of ancient religious places
and temples  of Uttaranchal
†*SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of CULTURE  be pleased to
state:
a) the names of the ancient religious
places and temples of Uttaranchal protected
by the Archaeological Survey of India;
(b) whether his ministry is working on
the schemes for protection and
development of these  places; and
(c) if so, the details thereof togetherwith
the amount spent  for this purpose during
the last two years year-wise and the amount
proposed to be spent during the year
2004-05?
Expenditure on education
*63. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA RAO:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a) the expenditure Government
propose to incur on education  during the
10th Five Year Plan;
(b) the percentage of GDP that
Government are planning to spend on
education during the above plan period;
(c) the amount spent so far on education
during the above plan, year-wise; and
(d) the contribution made by the States,
local  bodies and the Centre on education
in the first three years of the Plan?
Appointment in DD news
*64. SHRI NILOTPAL BASU:  Will the
Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that questionable
procedure was adopted by Government in

2
the past to appoint key people in
Doordarshan news;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps initiated by Government
to rectify the situation and fix
accountability therefor?
Levying of licence fee
*65. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are considering levying  of a licence fee
for ownership of TVs, for funding Prasar
Bharti's  activities; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Incentive to rose producers
*66. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
Pushkar in Rajasthan produces the best
export quality roses in the country;
(b if so, whether Government intend to
extend any special incentives to the rose
producers in Rajasthan  to further develop
its flower sector for export purpose; and
(c) is so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Disabled students
*67. SMT. N.P. DURGA: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that according to
the National  Centre for Promotion of
Employment for Disabled  People, only 1.2
percent of the disabled in the country  has
had any form of education
(b) whether his Ministry has  any
statistics as to how many disabled students
are studying in 322-odd universities in the
country; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Explosives in imported metal scrap
*68. SHRI LALIT SURI:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a) the countries from where metal scrap
was allowed to be imported during 2004;
(b) whether the imported metal scrap
contained explosive war-heads both used
and live that caused loss of life and property
as live war-heads exploded at various
places in the country;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the action taken/proposed to be
taken to ensure that such dangerous imports
are banned?
OBCs of other States
*69. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the OBCs of
other States are not treated as Other
Backward Classes in Delhi;
(b) if so, the  reasons  therefor; and
(c) whether Government would instruct
the Delhi Government to provide all the
facilities to OBCs of other States?

3
Allocation for school education
*70. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a) the allocation made for school
education during the last three years, year-
wise and State-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that education
cess is being collected;
(c) if so, the amount collected so far
and spent oneducation, State-wise;
(d) whether it is a fact that in rural and
far-flung areas, there is either no school or
where these exist, they lack proper
infrastructure and teaching staff; and
(e) if so, the measures contemplated to
strengt

List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the December 6, 2004/Agrahayana 15, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Culture; Development of North-Eastern
Region; Heavy Industries  and Public Enterprises; Human Resource Development;
Information and Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Parliamentary Affairs; Social
Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Urban Development; Urban
Employment and Poverty Alleviaion)
Total number of questions — 132
Dumping of e-waste
301. Smt. N.P. DURGA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Britain is
dumping e-waste such as broken computer
monitors, TVs, discarded mobile phones
etc every year in India;
(b) if so, the details of the e-waste
dumped during the last five years; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
stop this dumping?
Criteria for export of rice
302. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA RAO:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether any criterion has been laid
down to determine the eligibility for
subsidy for export of rice;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) how it is ensured that only export of
genuine non-Basmati rice to the Middle
East is put in a claim?
Trade relation with Libya
303. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Libya has
offered multi-sectoral scope for the Indian
firms;
(b) if so, the sectors which have been
thrown open; and
(c) the areas where the Indian firms have
already made a foray and the other areas
where they now propose to enterrrrr?
Gold Policy
304. SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are planning
to set up a panel to study the Gold policy;

2
(b)  whether there are any guidelines
for the panel;
(c) by when, the outcome of the study
is expected; and
(d) how far it would affect the Gold
Industry?
Growth of Cement Industry
305. SHRI M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the growth of cement
industry is very modest during the current
year as compared to the previous years;
(b) if so, the details of the growth rate
of cement industry during the last five
years, year-wise and State-wise;
(c)  whether Governmnet have
estimated the demand and supply of cement
in the country;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) the areas which are untapped or
neglected; and
(f) the steps Government propose to
take to maximise the cement production?
Quality standards for agricultural
products
306. SHRI SHARAD ANANTRAO
JOSHI: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the countries signatory to
the World Trade Organisation Agreement
on Agriculture have prescribed specific
quality and sanitary/photo sanitary
standards for different agricultural produce
they import;
(b) if so,  whether these standards are
uniform and identical for all the countries
of origin;
(c) what are the standards for the
commodities exported by India;
(d) what are the facilities, like testing
laboratories, available to farmers in the
country;
(e)  whether Government propose to
extend and improve these testing facilities;
and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Export of Industrial goods
307. SHRI MANOJ BHATTA-
CHARYA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the growth of exports
of industrial goods during the lastfive years,
year-wise and sector-wise;
(b) the impact thereof on
theemployment opportunities, year-wise;
and
(c) the steps proposed to be taken to
help the export-oriented industries to
achieve and sustain a higher growthy rate?
Rabber production
308. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of rubber production in
the country for the last thre years, year-
wise;
(b)  whether Government have recently
lifted all restrictions for rubber imports;
(c) if so, the details of rubber import
during the last three years, year-wise;
(d)  whether Government have felt the
need to allocate special funds tohelp
improve production in order to revive the
rubber industry;

3
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Limestone export
309. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that limestone
export from Rajasthan has been on a
gradual decline due to Government's
decision to reduce import duty and hike
rail and ocean freight charges;
(b) if so, the details of limestone export
durign the last five years, year-wise; and
(c) the steps Government propose to
take to revive limestone exports in the near
future?
Indo-South Korea Trade Agreement
310. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether any trade agreement was
signed between India and South Korea in
Oc
